introHtml: Black badge reels offer a professional, understated look that complements any uniform or dress code. Whether you need retractable reels with belt clips for security staff or jumbo oval reels for easy scanning, black keeps the focus on your logo. Choose from durable plastic, bamboo, or nylon styles to match your workplace environment. Add your company name or department via label or polydome decoration for a clean, cohesive ID solution.
